_comment: Replaces slate/census.json's cadence field for latency-investigation purposes. NEVER written back to slate/census.json. Leg A = real-world schedule (web research). Leg B = deep Kalshi ticker-date history (schedule-cross-check.py, kalshi-history.json). Every field cites its source; open_events_now is a live snapshot, not a standing fact -- Kalshi's /events objects carry no status field, so 'open' is determined by which status-filtered query returned the ticker (verified live 2026-08-05).

leg_a_real_schedule.source: docs/COMPETITOR-ANATOMY.md (already-confirmed prior finding, used here as the calibration row)

kxworldnewsmention.reconciliation_note: Leg B's near-daily cadence (median gap 1d, all weekdays + some Sat represented) independently reproduces Leg A's known 'daily' fact -- CALIBRATION PASSED: this validates the methodology before trusting it on new candidates below.
kxworldnewsmention.actionability: actionable-now (but PARKED separately on the linear-feed question -- out of scope for this table)

leg_a_real_schedule.local_time: no single anchor -- per-game first pitch, ballpark-local TZ, evenings predominate
leg_a_real_schedule.season_window: regular season ~late March - September/early Oct 2026, postseason through Oct/Nov
leg_a_real_schedule.source: general MLB scheduling knowledge (not freshly re-verified against mlb.com/schedule this pass -- flag as needs-live-reconfirm before treating as final)

leg_b_kalshi_history.open_events_note: 0 at this exact fetch moment (mid-afternoon UTC) is NOT evidence the market is dormant -- Aug 1 games already finalized, Aug 5 evening games' event objects likely hadn't posted status=open yet at fetch time. This is a MOVING TARGET across the day, re-check near first-pitch, not a standing fact.

kxmlbmention.reconciliation_note: 106 dated events over ~4.5 months, every day of week represented, median 1-day gap -- strongly confirms real nightly-during-season cadence. Matches the real-world MLB calendar structurally even without a fresh league-schedule-page pull.
kxmlbmention.actionability: watch-for-next-open (in-season, cadence confirmed fixed-nearly-daily, but no market open at fetch time -- re-check at evening game time)

kxtbpnmention.reconciliation_note: Leg A confirms TBPN airs LIVE every weekday -- but Leg B shows Kalshi only ever lists a board ~12 times over 9 months (median 12-DAY gap between listings), concentrated Wed-Fri. This is the exact 'real schedule is fixed, tradeable event is a narrow subset' case the methodology is designed to catch: the underlying show is genuinely daily, but Kalshi does NOT open a market for most episodes -- so this is NOT actionable-daily despite the fixed real-world schedule.
kxtbpnmention.actionability: watch-for-next-open (fixed real schedule, but Kalshi board opens rarely and unpredictably within that schedule)

Do not use this candidate's ticker date as a proxy for real air date without resolving this first.

kxsecpressmention.reconciliation_note: IMPORTANT CORRECTION to this repo's prior assumption: this candidate was previously treated as purely ad-hoc (docs/EXPANSION.md gives it no schedule claim at all). 59 dated events over ~17 months with a 5-day median gap is actually FAIRLY FREQUENT and reasonably regular -- briefings cluster Thu/Fri slightly more than other days but occur across the whole week, including weekends (9 Sat + 8 Sun, plausibly foreign-trip/breaking-news briefings). Also note: date_range extends to 2026-12-31, i.e. Kalshi has PRE-LISTED future event tickers far in advance for this series -- worth checking whether those far-future tickers are placeholder/templated rather than confirmed real briefings.
kxsecpressmention.actionability: watch-for-next-open (more frequent and regular than previously assumed in this repo, but no single fixed time-of-day found)
